components.markdown_content:
## NEGOTIATION RULES

⏱️ **Max 10 counter-offers** (total)
⏱️ **Offers expire in 72 hours**
📊 **Min 1% change required** per offer
💰 **Max 40% discount** allowed
✅ **Auto-accept at 5%** margin threshold

---

## WORKFLOW STEPS

**1.** Click "Negotiate" on product page
**2.** Enter your offer price
**3.** Add message (optional but recommended)
**4.** Wait for seller response
**5.** Accept or counter-offer
**6.** Complete purchase or continue

---

## ✅ BEST PRACTICES

• Start at **15-20% below** asking price
• Always **check seller rating** first
• **Respond within 24 hours**
• Include **context** in messages
• Know your **bottom line** before starting
• Be **professional** and respectful

---

## ⚠️ COMMON MISTAKES

✗ Don't lowball (**>40% off** rejected)
✗ Don't **ignore deadlines**
✗ Don't be **rude or aggressive**
✗ Don't **burn bridges** — B2B community is small
